value.name: Relentless
value.description: Doesn't slow down once it's committed to a fight, no matter how badly it's hurt.

value.name: Camouflaged
value.description: Blends into its surroundings well enough that most people walk right past it.

value.name: Regenerative
value.description: Wounds that would drop most things just slow it down.

value.name: Pack-Minded
value.description: Fights noticeably smarter when others of its kind are nearby.

value.name: Territorial
value.description: Rarely leaves its claimed ground, but is vicious about defending it.

value.name: Unnerving
value.description: Something about it makes people hesitate before engaging, even when they shouldn't.

_traitsActionsNote: traitsPool/actionsPool deliberately NOT genre-tagged -- these are abstract game-mechanical concepts (relentless, camouflaged, grapples, charges), not setting-specific flavor, and read fine unmodified in any genre.

value.name: Savage Strike
value.description: A brutal, close-range attack meant to end a fight fast.

value.name: Grapple
value.description: Tries to pin a target in place before the real damage starts.

value.name: Charge
value.description: Closes distance fast and hits hard on the way in.

value.name: Harrying Bite
value.description: A quick, repeated attack meant to wear a target down rather than end things in one blow.

value.name: Piercing Cry
value.description: A sound or signal that rattles anyone nearby, making them easier to hit.

flavorTemplates.value: {name} doesn't announce itself before it's already too late.
Whatever {name} used to be, it isn't anymore.
Locals have their own name for {name}, and it isn't a kind one.
{name} keeps to the places nobody else wants to go.
{name} has a reputation, and it's earned every bit of it.
The old stories have a name for {name}, and the new ones haven't improved on it.
{name} was picked apart by the wasteland long before it ever picked a fight.
Nobody's sure whether {name} was built, grown, or something in between.
{name} keeps turning up in the same three blocks, and the reports never quite agree on what it is.
Describing {name} accurately tends to make people stop wanting to look for it.

flavorStatsTemplates.value: Tough and aggressive up close, but not built for a drawn-out fight.
Fast and unpredictable -- hard to pin down, easy to underestimate.
Slow but devastating if it actually connects.
Wears an opponent down over time rather than overwhelming them outright.

designNotes.value: Procedurally rolled -- attributes/traits are table-generated, worth a manual pass before running it at the table.
